texto_aprovado: Then there are the animals with no venom at all. They killed more Australians than the venomous ones did: 154 over the same decade. Australia's national database of coroners' cases makes the same point: deaths from snakes, spiders, bees and the rest "remain relatively rare" next to deaths associated with other species.
